front_prompt: 1. Why do modern archaeologists prefer the name 'Indus-Sarasvatī Civilisation' over 'Indus Valley Civilisation'?
back_answer: Excavations over the past century revealed that major settlement clusters extended far beyond the Indus river valley, particularly along the dried-up bed of the ancient snow-fed Sarasvatī River and coastal Gujarat, making 'Indus-Sarasvatī' geographically accurate.
